<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update><sys_script_fix action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
<before>false</before>
<description/>
<name>Set Target Display Names</name>
<record_for_rollback>false</record_for_rollback>
<script><![CDATA[setNames();

function setNames() {
    var target = new GlideRecord('x_onpr_onpage_target');
    target.addNullQuery('display_name');
    target.query();
    while (target.next()) {
        setDN(target);
    }
}

function setDN(current) {
    var displayName = '';
    var docName = current.getDisplayValue('document_id'),
        opid = current.getValue('opid'),
        groupName = current.getValue('onpage_name'),
        firstName = current.getValue('first_name'),
        lastName = current.getValue('last_name');
	if (docName != '') {
        if (docName.contains("User: ")) {
            displayName = docName.replace('User: ', '');
        } else {
            displayName = docName.replace('Group: ', '');
        }
    } else if (firstName != null) {
        displayName = firstName + " " + lastName;
    } else if (groupName != null) {
        displayName = groupName;
    }
    if (opid != null) {
        displayName += " (" + opid + ")";
    }
    if (displayName == '') {
        displayName = current.getValue('id');
    }
    current.setValue('display_name', displayName);
	current.update();
}]]></script>
